title: Where to shop for baby products?
label: gear

posts.body:
Hi there,

Our little girl is due end of September and we wanna start purchasing some baby products, namely buggy, steriliser, bottles etc. We've been to Eugene Baby and had a look at Babycentre. Are there any other big baby stores out there?

posts.body: I hate bumps to babes. The staff in there is near useless and if anything is ever wrong with what your bought it is a major trial getting it fixed. There is a new one called Tiny Footprints I was in and it was awesome.

Try sham shui po or mongkok for clothes and Eugene baby or mothercare for other kids utilities....

Also there is a good stretch of kids shop in harbour city....I guess worth a check out..!

posts.body:
I normally go to Eugene baby, I find them better than Bumps to babes, a good variety. 

And yes, if you go to some local street markets, you can also find some great deals on baby wear.
